# Salmon Wallet

> Open-source, self-custodial wallet infrastructure for Solana. Available on the web, as a browser extension, and on Android.

Salmon keeps its wallet core lightweight and provides a structured, curated route for integrations. It does not expose a public transactional or custodial API from this website.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://salmonwallet.io/): Product overview, integration process, Powerups, validator information, and downloads
- [Privacy policy](https://salmonwallet.io/privacy): Privacy terms
- [Terms and conditions](https://salmonwallet.io/terms): Product terms
- [Sitemap](https://salmonwallet.io/sitemap.xml): Localized public URLs

## Machine-readable resources

- [OpenAPI](https://salmonwallet.io/openapi.json): Description of the website's public machine-readable surface
- [Markdown homepage](https://salmonwallet.io/): Request with `Accept: text/markdown`
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Salmon-HQ/salmon-wallet): Open-source wallet code

## Product access

- [Web wallet](https://v2.salmonwallet.io/)
- [Browser extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/salmon-wallet/ejbidfepgijlcgahbmbckmnaljagjoll)
- [Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.salmonwallet.app)
